systems.label: Skeletal
systems.tag: The frame everything else hangs on.
systems.text: Bones, cartilages, ligaments and the disks between the vertebrae. This layer carries load, protects the brain, the cord and the organs of the chest, and gives every muscle something to pull against.

systems.label: Muscular
systems.tag: The layer that moves the frame.
systems.text: Skeletal muscles with their tendons, plus the fascia and aponeuroses that wrap and anchor them. Each one crosses at least one joint and shortens to move it. The diaphragm sits here too, and it drives every breath.

systems.label: Cardiovascular
systems.text: Chamber walls and cavities of the heart, its valves and papillary muscles, then the arterial tree out and the venous tree back. This is the largest group in the model by a wide margin, because the source segments vessels branch by branch down to sub-segmental level.

systems.label: Nervous
systems.tag: Signal, from cortex to nerve ending.
systems.text: Brain regions, the ventricles and the fluid spaces, the commissures and deep nuclei, the cord and the named peripheral nerves. Cerebral and cerebellar arteries sit in the cardiovascular group, since they are vessels.

systems.label: Respiratory
systems.tag: The air path, branch by branch.
systems.text: Trachea, main bronchi and the bronchial tree down to segmental and sub-segmental level, with the larynx and epiglottis above it. The source has no lung parenchyma, so what you see is the airway itself rather than the tissue around it.

systems.label: Digestive
systems.tag: Mouth to rectum, plus the glands that feed it.
systems.text: The gut from the oesophagus through the stomach, small intestine and colon, with the liver segments, biliary tree, pancreas, gallbladder, salivary glands and the full adult dentition.

systems.label: Urinary
systems.text: Both kidneys, both ureters, the bladder and the urethra. Renal arteries and veins are grouped with the cardiovascular system.

systems.label: Reproductive
systems.text: The source model is an adult male, so this group holds the prostate, testes, epididymides, seminal vesicles, deferent ducts and the erectile bodies.

systems.label: Endocrine
systems.text: The pituitary and both adrenal glands are segmented as discrete organs here. The pineal body sits with the nervous group because the source classes it inside the brain.

systems.label: Lymphatic
systems.tag: Immune tissue with a blood supply.
systems.text: The spleen and both lobes of the thymus. The source does not segment lymph nodes or lymphatic vessels, so this group stays small.

systems.label: Special sense
systems.tag: The organs that take the world in.
systems.text: The eye segmented into cornea, sclera, iris, choroid, retina, lens and vitreous, with the lacrimal apparatus, the tarsal plates of the eyelids and the external ear.

systems.label: Integumentary
systems.text: The skin shell that encloses the whole model, plus scalp and body hair. Scroll past the opening and it comes off first, which is how every dissection starts.
